name: neuropathic pain overview
title: Neuropathic pain has a neurological cause and is recognized by its descriptors; after the cause is evaluated, one agent is chosen by the co-existing problem (amitriptyline for poor sleep or low cost, duloxetine for depression, carbamazepine for trigeminal neuralgia, gabapentinoids, topicals) with narcotics only as a last resort, and titrated by trial and error, early to avoid central sensitization; complex regional pain syndrome, pain beyond an injury, needs multidisciplinary pain management

root.title: NEUROPATHIC pain: a neurological cause, peripheral or central
lines: sounds like: electrical · shooting · burning, hot or cold · pins and needles
allodynia: a non-painful touch hurts · hyperpathia: a painful stimulus hurts far too much · dysesthesia: uncomfortable sensations (burning)
peripheral causes: length-dependent (diabetic, small fibre, chemotherapy) · radiculopathy · postherpetic neuralgia · trigeminal neuralgia · nerve injury
central causes: thalamus · brainstem · spinal cord · phantom limb pain partly central
EVALUATE THE CAUSE and examine: an important neurological diagnosis? some are reversible · nociceptive pain (tissue injury: somatic or visceral) takes acetaminophen, NSAIDs, opioids instead
